rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides automated access to the FLEX Student Portal used by NUCES (National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences) students in Pakistan. Uses Selenium for initial authentication with reCAPTCHA handling, then maintains session cookies for subsequent API calls to retrieve academic data including attendance records, marks/grades, transcripts, course registrations, and fee reports. Features intelligent HTML parsing for each data type and handles the portal's complex authentication flow including dump tokens for secure page access.
